faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

q1.question: How does automatic ordering work?
q1.answer: When an eBay buyer places an order, Zonds automatically places the corresponding order on Amazon using your connected buyer account, with the buyer’s shipping address. No manual clicking required.

q2.question: Can I still handle orders manually?
q2.answer: Absolutely. Automatic ordering is optional per order — you can step in and process any order manually whenever you want full control.

q3.question: How are tracking numbers handled?
q3.answer: Zonds monitors each Amazon order and, the moment a tracking number appears, pushes it to eBay and marks the order as shipped automatically.

q4.question: Can I set a different margin per product?
q4.answer: Yes. Unlike most tools, Zonds lets you define profit margin, stock cap and listing template individually for every ASIN — not one rule for your whole account.

q5.question: Which Amazon marketplaces are supported?
q5.answer: US, UK, Germany, France, Italy and Spain — sell across six Amazon marketplaces from a single dashboard.

q6.question: Is there a free plan?
q6.answer: Yes. The Starter plan is free forever with up to 25 listings, so you can try the full automation flow without a credit card.
